name: Will painting mobile home walls a light color hide the seams between panels?

mainEntity.name: Will painting mobile home walls a light color hide the seams between panels?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting your mobile home walls white or light neutral will brighten the rooms, but it may not hide panel seams unless you take specific steps. Light colors reflect more ambient light, which can actually cast subtle shadows along the edges of raised batten strips or uneven panel joints. If your goal is a completely flat, uniform appearance, you should have the batten strips removed, the panel joints taped and floated with drywall mud, and the full surface sanded flush before painting. Choosing an eggshell or matte finish will also minimize glare across those seams.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, light paint alone will not hide seams and can highlight batten strip shadows; achieving a seamless look requires removing strips, taping, and floating the joints first.
